title: Define vs Assign: Creating New vs Updating Existing Bindings
description: Define writes to the current scope and shadows ancestors. Assign walks the chain and updates the first matching binding.
source: draft: vibe free model + check fix: claude

steps.description: The Environment class with define, lookup, assign, and __repr__ for chain visualization.
outer defines x as 10, inner starts with parent outer and defines y as 20.
inner.define('x', 99) creates a new x binding in inner, shadowing outer's x.

steps.question: What does inner.lookup('x') return after the define

steps.description: outer2 defines x as 10, inner2 starts with parent outer2 and has no vars.
inner2.assign('x', 99) walks the chain and updates outer2's existing x binding.

steps.question: What does outer2.lookup('x') return after the assign

steps.description: Running prints inner.lookup('x') = 99, outer.lookup('x') = 10, inner2.lookup('x') = 99, outer2.lookup('x') = 99, and the chain inner:{'y': 20, 'x': 99} -> outer:{'x': 10}.
